alerts.invalidLink: YouTube link not recognised. Paste a link such as https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=… or https://youtu.be/…
alerts.needsServer:
YouTube cannot play videos when this page is opened as a local file (file://).

Serve it from a small local server instead, for example:
  python3 -m http.server 8000
then open http://localhost:8000/
alerts.youtubeFailed: Could not load the YouTube video:
alerts.unplayableVideo:
The browser cannot play this video.

Try an .mp4 (H.264 + AAC audio) or .webm file. .mkv files are often silent: their audio track (AC-3, DTS) cannot be decoded by a browser.
alerts.startFailedHint: Check that the camera is allowed and that the computer is online (needed the first time, to download the model).

youtube.embeddingDenied: The owner of this video does not allow it to be played outside YouTube. Try another one.
youtube.blockedHere: This video is blocked from playing on this page (embedding or origin restriction). Try another video, or open the page via http://localhost.

privacy:
🔒 Privacy: nothing leaves this computer.
No image, no video and no sound is ever recorded or sent over the internet. No account, no tracker, no analytics, no personal data collected.
Videos you open from your computer never leave it. Only your settings (sensitivity, delays, volume, language) are remembered in this browser, on this machine.
The code is fully open and auditable on GitHub.
One exception: if you pick a YouTube video, it is loaded from youtube-nocookie.com, which then applies its own rules.
